summary: Fixed. The bug was in `informerUpdate` (main.go:66-81): when a newer informer update evicted an assumed object, it silently deleted the entry with no callback. I added an `onConflict` hook on `AssumeCache`, invoked it at the eviction site with the dropped assumed object and the new one, and wired `main` to set `conflictNotified` from that hook. `test.sh` now passes (`PASS`).
